description: This is a Python source file defining a class `ConsumerProcessor` that extends `FrameProcessor`. The class consumes frames from a producer queue, handles different frame types (start, end, cancel), and manages a consumer task that processes frames asynchronously. It interacts with other modules like `pipecat.frames.frames` and `pipecat.processors.producer_processor`.
